decisions.reason: The multi-model electric panel line remains a publicly presented flagship of the firm's electrification direction, so the visible commitment and sunk development investment keep management persisting with it.
The halogen heater is less central and the firm has already pruned its electric range, but it still extends the infrared offer, and any weak results can be attributed to market timing.
The hydrogen-capable series was publicly launched in real operation and embodies the announced low-carbon strategy, so management will treat slow hydrogen uptake as temporary and stay committed.
